about_the_game: PACHINCRO! is an exciting incremental idle game where you drop balls down a pachinko-style board to boost your earnings. Inspired by classic peg-based games, your goal is to guide the balls to hit multipliers and increase your money higher with each drop. Unlock upgrades, new boards, and special features as you progress, and watch your wealth grow as you master the art of strategic ball drops. Perfect for anyone who loves casual, addictive gameplay with a satisfying loop of increasing rewards.
